findings.detail: POST /profile/upload-photo re-raises HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e)) for unexpected exceptions, potentially exposing Supabase SDK internals or file-system paths to the client. Replace with a generic message and log the original exception server-side.

findings.summary: Missing boundary-value tests for username/full_name length
findings.detail: No test exercises a username of exactly 3 or 20 characters, nor a full_name of exactly 3 or 50 characters. The {3,20} quantifier and the 3 <= len(stripped) <= 50 check are inclusive boundaries; off-by-one errors would go undetected. Add four parameterised cases.
